title: Automated Driving Safety Case Report
description: A report documenting the tested performance of an automated driving system's human-oversight fallback and safety safeguards, including driver-engagement monitoring results and emergency-braking configuration.
evidence_description: A report documenting how an automated driving system's human-oversight fallback was tested (including driver-engagement monitoring performance), confirmation that automatic emergency braking remained enabled during autonomous operation, and a log of disengagement/near-miss events reviewed.
collection_method: Combination of automated telemetry (engagement monitoring, braking configuration) and periodic manual safety review.
retention_period: Minimum 5 years, aligned with typical vehicle safety record-keeping expectations.
artifact_format: PDF safety case report; underlying telemetry retained as structured data.

citations.title: Collision Between Vehicle Controlled by Developmental Automated Driving System and Pedestrian, Tempe, Arizona, March 18, 2018 (NTSB/HAR-19/03)
